How a match works

Bounce to claim

The board is a 6 by 10 notebook grid. The tile where the ball bounces becomes the land of the player who hit it. A miss loses land.

Hit the center

Catch the ball with the center of your paddle for a smash. A smash claims 3 tiles at once.

Quick matches, then a showdown

A match takes about 90 seconds. The final seconds are a showdown.

6 AI rivals, 2 leagues

Every match is you against an AI rival. There are 6 AI rivals across 2 leagues at launch, with more planned in updates.
